The city that houses this basilica is Vatican City, whose head of state (and the head of the Catholic Church) is the Pope.

The office that once existed in Vatican City was that of **Governor of the Vatican City State**.  
That position was **abolished on 21 March 1952**, which marks the end of the governor’s term.

**Answer:** **21 March 1952**.
